sc: 10 Treasure Hunter keys could be won as a shadow gem rarity reward from the Crystal Capsules Treasure Hunter promotion.
It was a guaranteed reward from using the first key during the promotion.
As the keys were automatically redeemed, they couldn't be obtained as an item.

Amare Wings.x: Amare Wings is a male-only wings slot cosmetic override. It is part of the Amare outfit.

sc: An antique lamp is an item dropped by TokHaar-Hok when he is defeated after challenging the player in the Fight Cauldron.
The lamp can be obtained multiple times.
There are six artefacts, all of which are obtained during the first stage of the quest by digging in the unfinished train tunnel in Dorgesh-Kaan using a trowel.
An augmented Deathdealer robe top is armour created by using an augmentor on a tier 90 deathdealer robe top, or by upgrading a tier 80 augmented Deathdealer robe top.

The Third Age-dyed augmented off-hand drygore mace is a level 90 Melee off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a off-hand drygore mace (third age), or by using third age dye on an augmented off-hand drygore mace.

Barbarian assault ticket - wave 7.x: The Barbarian assault ticket - wave 7 is an item that is obtained from Captain Cain or Commander Connad by requesting to change your current wave in Barbarian Assault from wave seven back to wave one, or attempting to enter the wave one lobby.

sc: Cosmetic variants of the black full helms can be received as a possible reward from an easy clue scroll.
As with all black equipment, this item cannot be made from raw materials using the Smithing skill.
The blessed pot is a quest item created by taking a silver pot (spice) to be blessed by the High Priest on Entrana, or by adding spice to a blessed pot (blood).

r: Partial completion of Mourning's End Part I
sc: A blue toad is obtained during the quest Mourning's End Part I by using blue dye bellows on a toad.
A cadantine potion (unfinished) is an unfinished potion created by using a clean cadantine on a vial of water.

Clue scroll (elite) - Fremennik Slayer D.x: Clue scroll (elite) is a scan clue obtained from elite sealed clue scrolls. Players may find this map, showing the locations of the dungeon's monsters, useful when navigating the area.

sc: Clue scroll (medium) is a coordinate clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
The corrupted Ascension signet I is an item dropped by Legio Primus that can be used to unlock the miniature-boss pet Legio Primulus.
Croesus's enriched root is the unlock item for the Little Sus boss pet and is dropped by Croesus.
When obtained, it will be placed in the Croesus Reward Chest.

The cw super energy potion is a reward from Castle wars, and is a part of the melee potion set, ranged potion set, and magic potion set, each of which costs one silver Castle wars ticket and can only be consumed while playing Castle wars.

Death Reaper Vestments.x: The Death Reaper Vestments are a cosmetic override outfit that is obtained as part of the Death Reaper Vestments Set. It is an upgraded version of the Death Bringer Vestments, unlocked by completing 25 Slayer assignments while having any Death Seeker or Death Bringer cosmetic active.

sc: The decorated cooking urn (full) is an urn made by fully filling a decorated cooking urn while cooking food.
Full urns can also be teleported automatically by toggling the "Auto-teleport current skilling urn when full" option, which can be found under skilling options in miscellaneous gameplay settings.
They could originally be unlocked by owning all pieces of the Fire warrior outfit, which could be won from Treasure Hunter.
They could later be unlocked by purchasing the Fire warrior outfit override pack from the Marketplace for 1,500 oddments.

Eastern skirt (blue).x: The blue eastern skirt is part of the eastern outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: With 105 Runecrafting, it can be created by using Ilme's thread and 100 magical thread on any elemental or catalytic altars; necrotic and the Ourania altars will not work.

q: Ability to wear Berserker, Warrior, Farseer, and Archer helms.
sc: To obtain, you can buy one from Skulgrimen in Rellekka, trade with another player, or receive one from a Dagannoth on Waterbirth Island or in the Chaos Tunnels.
It can also be obtained by gambling 30 honour points in Barbarian Assault.

Flesh-hatchling Mhekarnahz.x: Flesh-hatchling Mhekarnahz is a boss pet that can be unlocked as a pet from Mhekarnahz's eye. The chance of obtaining the item as a drop from killing Flesh-hatcher Mhekarnahz is 1 in 800, with a threshold of 200 (explanation of drop mechanics).

The Havensilver longsword +1 is a tier 30 main-hand melee weapon made from havensilver.

It can be redeemed to unlock the Herald's Trousers and Herald's Boots cosmetic overrides, destroying the token in the process after a confirmation prompt.

sc: The Incomplete ivory idol (with the body, arms and legs) is created by combining an ivory idol body, ivory idol arms and ivory idol legs.
It, along with the regular Invention master skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached level 120 Invention.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Invention master skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has level 120 Invention.
It, along with the regular Runecrafting master skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached virtual level 120 Runecrafting.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Runecrafting master skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has virtual level 120 Runecrafting.
They could be obtained by completing tasks during the Tribal Trials Treasure Hunter promotion.
Cooked Karambwanji paste is made by grinding up a cooked karambwanji with a pestle and mortar.
Raw karambwanji paste should instead be made by grinding raw karambwanji.

Lesser demon claw.x: Lesser demon claw is an item used in the 2011 Christmas event. Two of them are obtained from Timmy, the pet lesser demon on the second floor of the Wizards' Tower, for use in the Christmas pudding being made by Kris and Kringle.

sc: The list may be used to seek out descendants of ancient residents of Varrock, and can be found by searching the scrolls on the library floor at the Varrock Palace.

Meadweaver Hat.x: Meadweaver Hat is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Meadweaver Outfit. It is unlocked at 12,000 nectar during The Need for Mead event.

sc: A medium XP lamp (Farming) is a fairly common prize from Treasure Hunter.

Menaphos Faction (Merchant) Head.x: Faction head (merchant district) is a cosmetic override reward from the Merchant district of Menaphos for having 18,000 reputation with that district.

sc: The Mourner's mask is a head slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 8 of Yak to the Light event.

sc: A mystery gift is an item that can be received from Christmas Village.

The mystery gift can be purchased by all players, and all players except for Group Ironman Mode players can receive it from Santa Claus or the Pile of Santa's Presents once they have claimed all cosmetic rewards.
Obliteration is a degradable tier 87 two-handed magic weapon, available as a reward from Slayer as a possible drop from a Wilderness slayer chest.
Before the removal of Bounty Hunter, the weapon could be bought from Bounty Hunter & Deathmatch Reward Shop for 30,000 Bounty Hunter points.
To obtain this item, players must partake in smithing a ceremonial sword after randomly being given plans when they finish smithing an item in the Artisans' Workshop.
Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play.
It may be produced using the Smithing skill or obtained as a monster drop.
The Onyx Gala Attire Jacket is a torso slot cosmetic override that is part of the Onyx Gala Attire outfit, obtained by redeeming a Onyx Gala Attire token.
The onyx necklace is made by using a gold bar, an onyx, and a necklace mould on a furnace.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 3 orikalkum bars and orikalkum platelegs, requiring 1,680 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,050 Smithing experience.

q: The ability to turn a cat's colour purple by talking to Wendy
sc: In order to obtain a pet cat, a player must complete the Gertrude's Cat quest to get a kitten from Gertrude.

If players have an activated ring of charos, obtained during the Garden of Tranquillity quest, then they are able to charm Gertrude into allowing them to choose what colour kitten they receive while purchasing a kitten.
The petition form is given to the player during the Ghosts Ahoy quest to collect signatures from ghost villagers in Port Phasmatys.
Ten signatures are needed for it to be completed, but they can be obtained from the same two villagers over and over.
A pot of cornflour is made by grinding raw sweetcorn in a windmill.

It is a drop from Night-gazer Khighorahk.
Prismatic crystal fragments were obtained from rubbing a Crystal amulet.
Three could be obtained per day, and give the same amount of bonus experience as a small prismatic fallen star in any skill.

They cannot be obtained by players without level 75 in each of the prerequisite skills for the quest Plague's End; if the player is lacking these levels, they will receive a prismatic crystal instead.
The Protector's ward is a somewhat powerful shield that can only be obtained as an uncommon drop from a spiritual guardian in Daemonheim.

Replica Metal (t) Platebody.x: The Replica Metal (t) Platebody is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica Metal Plate Armour pack.

sc: The right banana of knowledge is a possible reward from completing Ifaba's farming request at Manor Farm.

They can be made at a forge and anvil using 1 rune bar, requiring 600 progress to complete, granting a total of 240 Smithing experience.

It is made by using sacred clay (class 5) on a creation kiln in Stealing Creation, requiring level 80 Summoning to make and use.
The Sameowrai's faulds token is an unlock token that is a possible reward from Treasure Hunter during the Catwalk: The Sameowrai promotion.
It can be obtained as a reward from completing an elite clue scroll, or as reward from the Giant Oyster.

Seeker's charms are dropped by seekers, and are offered to the portal in the northern part of the stalker dungeon to grant the player Stalker Gaze, which increases the chance of elite soulgazers appearing from 1/50 to 1/10.
The boost in the elite soulgazer spawn rate from using seeker's charms is a global boost, and works everywhere; players do not need to kill the soulgazers in the stalker dungeon to benefit.
The shadowstep aura override token is a cosmetic token reward from the Assassin's Return Treasure Hunter promotion.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Shadowstep Aura override.
